brief:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu pressed Qatar to continue its financial support for Gaza even after Israeli military and security officials warned against the arrangement, according to a Channel 12 investigation, Middle East Eye reported. The probe found that Doha provided Israeli military and security officials with gifts valued in the tens of thousands of dollars.

The investigation did not specify the timeframe of Netanyahu's pressure or the exact amounts Qatar channeled into Gaza under the arrangement.

title: Netanyahu urged Qatar to keep funding Gaza despite Israeli security warnings
